# freshdesk_custom_object_schemas (Data Source)

Every custom object schema on the helpdesk.

-> Custom objects require a plan that enables the feature. Accounts without it answer `403` on this endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_custom_object_schemas" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `custom_object_schemas` (Attributes List) Every custom object schema the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_object_schemas))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source. Always `custom_object_schemas`.

<a id="nestedatt--custom_object_schemas"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_object_schemas`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the schema was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the custom object.
- `fields` (String) The object's fields, as JSON.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the custom object schema.
- `name` (String) Name of the custom object.
- `prefix` (String) Prefix Freshdesk gives the object's record IDs.
- `updated_at` (String) When the schema was last changed (RFC 3339).
